figurative_meaning_en: To enjoy a desired object through imagination or wishful thinking
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় ফেল করেও সে মনকলা খেয়ে স্বপ্ন দেখছে।
অর্থ না থাকলেও মনকলা খেয়ে সে ভ্রমণের কল্পনা করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Even after failing the exam, he's indulging in wishful thinking about success.
Without money, he's enjoying imaginary travels by eating mind-bananas.
note: This idiom humorously conveys self-consolation through fantasy, common in Bengali colloquial speech.
